snippet.title: Golden Axe Meets King Arthur! Blades & Battles - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Sharpen your blade and prepare for battle! 

Blades & Battles officially launches September 29, 2026 for PC (Steam & Epic Games Store), PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch! (Nintendo Switch release in Japan & Asia on October 1st).

TRY THE FREE DEMO & WISHLIST ON STEAM: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284260/Blades_Battles/?utm_source=youtube

Blades & Battles is a visceral 2.5D Beat’em Up inspired by timeless arcade sword-fighting classics like Golden Axe, Knights of the Round, Rastan Saga, and Magic Sword.

Set before the founding of the Round Table, take control of a young Arthur or the agile knight Lancelot as they fight through a mythical Camelot besieged by dark legions, corrupted beasts, and the wicked sorceress Morgana le Fay.

#Beatemup #RetroGaming #IndieGames
